[ok] Copied 2 files to components/astryx/HStack/

What @astryxdesign/core exports is imported from @astryxdesign/core; the internal modules the component needs are copied beside it.
You can now customize the component source freely.

Marked components/astryx/ with astryx-swizzle.json: with @astryxdesign/build's Babel, PostCSS and Vite integrations, or withAstryx() under webpack, every module under it compiles below your theme, so theme overrides reach the copy. Keep only swizzled copies there. Turbopack does not read the marker yet.

Customizing a component often signals a gap in the design system.
Let the maintainers know what you needed:
  https://github.com/meta/astryx/issues/new
